# Historical Unix Source Reference

This directory is reserved for the authoritative public Unix historical source reference used by VodyaOS.

Current source:
- https://github.com/dspinellis/unix-history-repo
- branch: Research-PDP7-Snapshot-Development

This repository is a historical reference for studying Unix V7 and related early system design. It is not a fork of the official Bell Labs source, but a public archival reference for research and education.
